title: S63 — Census: corrosion family deep-failure map (fresh items, per-stage categories)
desc: NEW-OP STARTER. GOAL: generate fresh, non-canonical corrosion items (~40; seeds ≥900 — never 1-4 or 53) with generator.py, read them, and categorize EVERY failure by stage (preclassify / segmentation / classification) with counts, examples and a committed gallery. WHY: canonical suites hold only ~8 corrosion items; real rates and stage attribution need fresh samples. S43 says segmentation owns 82% of the hard residue; corrosion is the classifier wall (S43). READ FIRST: reports/s43_failure_analysis.md, reports/s55-postprocess-audit.md (what is already closed), reports/stage-diagnosis.json. STEPS: gen fresh set → plain floor read + reader_lex read + per-stage diagnostics (tools/stage_diagnosis.py, S25-style piece inspection) → category table + one example per category in the gallery. IF your census fingerprints a mechanism matching a CLOSED lane (adaptive threshold / CLAHE / edge enhancement / morph-close / size-window / straight-column / S56 seam): say so explicitly and propose the next DIFFERENT mechanism — do not re-run closed lanes. EVIDENCE: reports/census-corrosion/<date>.md + gallery/ + PUSHES row + formalcode line. BOUNDARIES: diagnostics only, no shipping edits, no canonical-seed generation. Boundaries: no edits to shipping paths unless the task says so; no tuning on canonical seeds 1/2/3/4/53 (evaluation only); honest numbers — no 98/95 claims; captchaproject(s) off-limits.
